description: TU Delft publishes cased-hole wireline measurements from injector DEL-GT-02-S2 of its campus geothermal doublet. The campaign measured reservoir baseline conditions after perforation and before cooling. Described measurements include circumferential borehole imaging, acoustic logs, a reservoir-performance monitor and inclination. The release contains composite PDF logs and LAS and DLIS well-log files, with several display scales. Coverage: Coverage is the Delft campus geothermal site in the Netherlands. The description specifies November 2025; the custom time-coverage field specifies 2026. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: The source date conflict is preserved. Sampling intervals and the interpretation of individual instrument measurements were not independently established. Simulation uses include geothermal baseline-state and reservoir calibration. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
